fact: A UNESCO IICBA request for proposals dated 14 May 2026 says Lesotho's district education offices collect, validate and transmit school-level information into the national EMIS, and commissions, with GPE-KIX funds, a two-day workshop for about 50 district education officers on data entry and reporting on the national EMIS/DHIS2 platform, to be delivered by 20 August 2026.
title: Request for Proposal: Consultancy for Capacity Building for EMIS District Officers in Lesotho and Capacity Building on Education Data Use and Inter-Ministerial Coordination in Lesotho and Eswatini
publisher: UNESCO International Institute for Capacity Building in Africa (IICBA)
